senses.gloss: m. (שָׁלַף) [sliding,] pouch on an animal’s back, saddle-bag, haversack.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 154b:2-7">Sabb. 154ᵇ</cite> <he>היתה … טעונה ש׳ וכ׳</he> if (on the entrance of the Sabbath) his beast was carrying a bag full of grain, let him … pull it towards one side, so that it slips down of itself; Tosef. ib. XVIII, 1.
<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Kamma 1:6">Tosef. B. Kam. I, 6</cite>; Y. ib. I, beg. 2ᵃ.
<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Batra 4:2">Tosef. ib. IV, 2</cite>; a. e.
